posts.title: I Built a Portfolio Website That Doubles as Its Own CMS. No Backend Required.
posts.summary: I built a configurable, forkable portfolio platform with Next.js, using GitHub as its CMS and GitHub Actions for deployment. Here's how its architecture, configuration system, migrations, and automation work without a custom backend.
